editorial.blurb: Kamehachi is Old Town's trusted sushi destination, where expertly crafted rolls with fresh, high-quality ingredients and creative combinations keep locals coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the spicy tuna roll—reviewers consistently praise it—and clarify pricing on any complimentary add-ons with your server before they arrive at the table.

topDishes.note: Fresh, flavorful, and a reliable standout
